title: A part sale's Credit Hold badge follows the payer
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for, on the COD credit term.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, on the Credit Hold credit term.
  • Have a new part sale for this test, part sale 1, for customer A, open, billed to customer B.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part sale 1 opens for customer A.
  • The part sale header shows a "Credit Hold" badge for customer B, as the work order's badge does.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12309 (Story 7, Invoicing to the Bill To)

  • S7-R11: “The work order's Credit Hold and Over Limit badges describe the Bill To.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
